# agy-capsule

Real-time context window usage, multi-model quota, cache status, generation speed, and turn telemetry plugin for Antigravity.

## Composer Footer & Popovers

Injects a shadow-DOM metrics strip into the Antigravity composer footer via the local DevTools (CDP) endpoint:

- **Enhanced model capsule** (optional, off by default): A model panel that matches the native look. Click a model to keep your current effort level.
- **Context capsule**: Live context usage percentage (`0 / --` before the first turn), optional **Generation speed** (latest completed request in the current turn), and optional **Effects** (breathing dot while generating: red `<10 tok/s`, yellow `10–25 tok/s`, green `≥25 tok/s`; retains speed color for 15s after completion before graying out).
- **Quota capsule**: Matched model pool quotas (`5 Hours` and `Weekly`) across `Gemini`, `Claude`, `Argon`, and `Carbon`, with reset countdowns. When no subscription quota is returned and Antigravity confirms the account uses Cloud pay-as-you-go billing, the entire quota capsule is hidden.
- **Third capsule — Request failure & First-token wait alert** (both optional; request failure takes priority):
  - **Request failure**: Appears in red when a request fails, classifying `Quota exhausted`, `Rate limited` (429 + retry wait when reported), `Disconnected`, `Authentication error`, `Service busy`, or `Unknown reason` with raw diagnostics in its panel.
  - **First-token wait alert**: An amber capsule appears when a wait reaches the threshold (default `30s`, range `1–999s`). `Wait×2 40s` means two intervals reached the threshold this turn, including a current estimate of 40 seconds. Active tools and streaming stop the live clock. Earlier slow waits remain visible in the panel.
- **Hover & click-to-pin**: Hover any capsule to open its popover panel; click to pin it open (click again, click outside, or press `Escape` to close).
- **4-level narrow-width progressive fallback**: When composer width shrinks, degrades in stages (collapses Turbo selector / hides speed and error label → hides secondary quota window → hides quota and context percentages down to icon-only → ellipsis-truncates the model selector and hides remaining capsules if space is exhausted) to preserve hover access without overlap.

## Sidebar (`… → Extensions → agy-capsule`)

Provides **Statistics** and **Settings** tabs at the top (settings live exclusively in the Sidebar; the composer footer displays capsules and popovers). Theme always follows host CSS variables (`Source Han Sans` with local system-UI font fallbacks).

- **Languages** (`en` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW`): Independent **Display language** (`en` default, for stats/panels) and **Settings language** (`zh-CN` default, for the Settings UI).
- **Appearance**:
  - **Panel height**: `natural` (default) or `matched`
  - **Panel spacing**: `compact` (default), `standard`, or `spacious`
  - **Label casing**: `lowercase` (default) or `titlecase`
  - **Quota indicator**: `ring` (default) or `bar`
  - **Cache indicator**: `icon` (default), `ring`, or `bar` (linear progress over elapsed idle time: green → yellow → full red)
  - **Reset countdown**: `compact` (default) or `localized`
- **Features** (unified section):
  - **Enhanced model capsule**: `false` — with **Keep native button** (`true`), **Hide model tags** (`false`), **Hide default effort** (`false`), and **Customize models** (`false`, persists `hiddenModels` in `settings.json`)
    - **Effort bar**: `false` — replaces hover submenus with an animated slider and keeps the menu open after selecting a model. Right-click the slider for animation, tick mark, and style options.
  - **Highlight active model**: `false` (dims non-active quota pools when enabled)
  - **Hide absent quota windows**: `true` (hides empty windows such as Argon's missing 5h window on AI Pro)
  - **Cache expiry alert**: `true` with configurable yellow/red thresholds (`cacheWarnMin`: `3m`, `1–998`; `cacheColdMin`: `4m`, `2–999`; synced with panel Cache row)
  - **Context overload alert**: `true` (capsule text turns yellow above 75% and red above 90%)
  - **Request failure alert**: `true`
  - **Restart recovery notice**: `true` (if the debug port is unavailable after a launch without the debugging flag and the footer capsule previously worked, shows a sidebar notice with Windows shortcut detection / one-click restore and sends at most one desktop notification per session)
  - **Generation speed** (`true`) + **Effects** (`false`; automatically forced off when speed is disabled)
  - **Context breakdown**: `true`; `columns` (default) or `rows`, `square` (default) or `dot` markers, with toggleable and drag-reorderable column fields (`Name`: `true`, `Value`: `true`, `%`: `false`; default order `label,value,percent`)
  - **Last request**: `true` (shows `TTFT–total duration` range and generation speed)
  - **Turn metrics**: `false`; `columns` (default) or `rows`, `square` (default) or `dot` markers
  - **First-token wait alert**: `true` with configurable threshold (`queueWarnSec`: `30s`, `1–999`)
- **Usage history** (dedicated section at the bottom of Settings, with `?` scope tooltip):
  - **Token activity**: `false` (sidebar statistics only: today / this week / this month / all-time usage and a daily or weekly activity map of the past year, with four-part breakdowns on hover; nothing is read while it is off)
  - **Usage by model**: `false` (sidebar statistics only: stacked bars per model family by day, week or month with paging to earlier periods, and a per-family list with tokens, share, four-part breakdown and per-tier hover split; shares the scan above, and nothing is read while both are off)

## Telemetry & Metric Definitions

- **Ground-truth SQLite telemetry**: Reads exact API token counts (`uncached_input`, `cached_input`, `output_tokens`, `thinking_tokens`) from the current host's `conversations/<id>.db` and resolves context limits from model metadata. Custom data roots are identified via `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR`. Without a host path, the plugin looks for that chat ID under `~/.gemini/{antigravity,antigravity-ide,antigravity-cli}`.
- **Compaction-aware breakdown**: Computes active context usage from the latest billed turn (`uncached_input + cached_input`) and resets 4-category accumulation (`Turn0`, `Read`, `Think`, `Write`) at the latest compaction checkpoint (`step_type = 23` or token-drop fallback).
- **Generation speed**: `total output ÷ (TTFT + streaming time)` for the latest completed model request (`output = reply + thinking`; excludes tool execution; missing or zero timings yield `—`).
- **Last request**: Covers only the most recent recorded model request (`TTFT–request duration` and speed); unrelated to full-turn totals.
- **Turn metrics**: Aggregates elapsed wall-clock time (including queueing, waits, and tool execution), request count (recorded retries included; pure preflight/injected responses excluded), `Write`, and `Think` tokens starting from the latest sent user message.
- **Cache expiry estimate**: The warning / cold status (default `3m` / `4m`, configurable in Settings) is estimated locally from elapsed time since the last recorded step; actual cache hits depend on the server.
- **First-token wait alert** combines reported request TTFT with local step timing. The live estimate may start when processing the message begins or after a previous step finishes; it does not use the time the message was queued. The cause is unknown. The count resets when processing the next message begins.
- **Usage history**: Sums `input_tokens` (uncached), `cache_read_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens` and `output_tokens` of every recorded model request across `conversations/*.db` in the current product data folder, dated in the local time zone (weeks start on Monday). Totals include cache reads (usually dominant in long chats, with no direct conversion to quota consumption) and are not a bill; deleted conversations are excluded, and a response stored in several files counts once with a deterministic tie-breaker. Databases are read incrementally with event-loop yields and only while at least one usage option is on and Statistics is open; idle closed databases without a non-empty `-wal` are opened with `immutable=1`, while active or recently modified databases use plain read-only with before/after `.db`/`-wal` fingerprint verification (discarding torn mid-read changes for the next scan). Models prefer `model_display_name` with fallback to `response_model` (or "Unknown model") and strip effort-tier suffixes to group by model family by default (tier splits appear on hover; beyond 6 families, the smallest share "Other models"). Totals stay in memory only.

## Install / Update / Uninstall

Run the scripts from the repository root:

| Action | Windows | macOS / Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Install | `install.bat` | `sh install.sh` |
| Update | `update.bat` *(pull latest code first)* | `sh update.sh` *(pull latest code first)* |
| Uninstall | `uninstall.bat` | `sh uninstall.sh` |

- Install and update sync this plugin directory to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-capsule` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-capsule` on Windows) and prune stale files from prior versions.
- Preferences are stored separately at `~/.gemini/config/agy-capsule/settings.json` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\agy-capsule\settings.json` on Windows) and are preserved across updates and uninstalls (missing keys fall back to defaults).
- **Self-reload watcher**: Polls installed runtime files every 1s (honoring `.update-in-progress` batch markers) and cleans up/exits after a 1.5s quiet period so Antigravity restarts the sidecar and reconnects open sidebars automatically. Updating from older versions without this watcher requires one manual plugin restart.

## Credits & Notices

- Selected features and visual/engineering ideas (multi-language support, panel visuals, active-model highlighting, click-to-pin, generation speed/effects, cache & quota tooltips, overload alerts, error classification, absent window hiding, style isolation, SQLite snapshot caching, incremental CDP pushes, and install maintenance) were adapted and reimplemented from [z21100644's PR #1](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/pull/1). Separate display/settings languages, independent appearance controls, the third failure capsule, narrow-width fallback order, turn metrics, and sidebar interactions were designed independently; 7-category context estimates and attachment scanning were not adopted.
- Quota popover overflow under browser/page translation extensions was reported with a proposed fix in [Krwaby123's PR #2](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/pull/2), resolved here via column alignment and no-translate attributes.
- Reading host model options from the Antigravity model trigger's React fiber tree for one-step model/effort selection was inspired by [antigravity-Codex-Claude-effort-slider](https://github.com/LLYSH-HANNARI/antigravity-Codex-Claude-effort-slider), reimplemented here via the CDP injector with Antigravity 2.33 / new-chat support, hover effort submenus, effort inheritance, and model list customization.
- The optional effort bar incorporates its slider visuals and animations with the author's permission. See [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).
- The usage history's daily / weekly activity map and usage-by-model bars follow the idea of the usage window in [wycocoyu/agy-context-dashboard](https://github.com/wycocoyu/agy-context-dashboard) (MIT), reimplemented here on the local conversation databases instead of the local API and without a ledger of its own.

# agy-capsule **中文** | [English](./README.en.md) 在 Antigravity 输入框底栏显示上下文占用、多模型配额、缓存状态和生成速度，悬停胶囊即可查看面板详情，点击胶囊即可固定面板。 使用的是 **Antigravity IDE 独立编辑器**？可直接在 IDE 的扩展面板搜索 `agy-capsule-ide` 安装，或到 [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/lumidarin/agy-capsule-ide/) 查看。详见 [IDE 版安装与功能](./ide/README.md)，以及 [App 与 IDE 的差异](./docs/ide-preview.md)。下文介绍桌面 App 版。

宣传片（v1.4，也可以在 [B 站](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1bayvz5Ey1/) 观看）： https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3857a452-9fac-42b0-8f26-57759af8fefc
往期宣传片（v1.1） 也可以在 [B 站](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1ggsy6rEQM/) 观看： https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f5bf1c6-1284-4e17-a380-defdee83f60c
本插件几乎所有功能都支持高度自定义，无论是极简底栏还是全面监控都能按需组合；下方带 `☑` 的条目均可在侧栏[设置](#设置)中自由开关或调整。 ## 上下文 显示上下文占用、缓存命中率与缓存状态。上限按当前会话和模型实时读取。 ☑ **显示缓存命中率**：默认关闭。开启后，第一个胶囊在上下文占用旁显示缓存命中率；没有实测数据或空间不足时，底栏不显示该数值。 ☑ **缓存过期提醒**：胶囊图标距上一轮默认满 3 分钟变黄、满 4 分钟变红 `Cache` 过期，右侧输入框可自定义变黄/变红分钟数（上限 998 / 999 分钟）。面板里的 Cache 行同步变化。 ☑ **上下文过载提醒**：上下文超过 75% 时，胶囊数字变黄，超过 90% 时变红。 ☑ **生成速度**：显示本轮最近一次请求的速度，每完成一次请求更新一次。 ☑ **速度动效**：在模型生成回复时会闪烁的小圆点。在生成速度低于 10 tok/s 时红色，10 至低于 25 时黄色，25 及以上绿色。停下后保持颜色 15 秒再变灰。 ☑ **上下文明细**：将上下文拆分成首轮、读取、思考、写入四个部分，分别显示数值和占比。可选横条显示或竖列显示。横条显示可选方块或圆点标记。竖列显示可逐项开关名称、数值、百分比，可自由调节顺序。 ☑ **最近请求**：显示最近一次请求从首 token 到结束的耗时范围（如 `4.5s–8.6s`）和生成速度。 ☑ **本轮统计**：显示本轮的耗时、请求数、思考和写入。 ## 额度 显示当前或所有额度池的 5 小时与每周剩余额度和重置倒计时。 **Vertex AI（Google Cloud 按量计费）**：当未返回套餐额度且 Antigravity 确认账号使用 Cloud 按量计费时，隐藏整个额度胶囊。 ☑ **突出当前模型**：高亮当前所选模型所在的额度池，弱化其他池。 ☑ **隐藏不存在的配额窗口**：例如 AI Pro 用户的 Argon 池没有 5 小时额度，会被隐藏掉。 ## 报错与首字等待提醒 共用底栏第三胶囊（同时触发时优先显示请求失败）： ☑ **请求失败提醒**：仅在请求失败时弹出红色胶囊，悬停或点击后可在面板上查看原始报错和相关说明。请求超时和断连分别显示，单次请求超时不代表整轮停止。其他原因包括额度耗尽、限流（429）、验证异常、服务繁忙和未知原因。 ☑ **首字等待提醒**：本轮等待达到阈值时显示黄色胶囊（默认 `30s`，可设 `1–999s`）。`等待×2 40s` 表示本轮有两段等待达到阈值，当前一段估计为 40 秒。工具执行和流式输出会停止实时计时，历史提醒仍可查看。 ## 模型 关闭「模型」页顶部的「退回原生模型胶囊」，即可在底栏原位替换原生模型按钮。插件面板保留原生外观，直接点击模型会继承当前强度。退回原生时，本页功能暂时停用，已选设置会保留。 ☑ **隐藏模型标签**：隐藏菜单中的 `New`、`Notice` 等标签徽章。 ☑ **隐藏默认强度**：在下拉模型列表中隐藏档位预览（底栏当前档位与右侧展开的子菜单照常显示，直接点击仍按规则继承强度）。 ☑ **模型圆点**：在模型名称旁显示彩色圆点。 ☑ **定制模型列表**：开启后自动展开当前可用的模型列表，点击即可按模型隐藏或恢复显示（不会隐藏到列表为空）。 ☑ **思考强度滑条和Orchestrator胶囊**：开启后，点模型不关面板，也不再弹出悬停子菜单。可在底部点击或用方向键直接切档；拖动时预览档位，松手后再切换。支持 Orchestrator 时也会显示对应的胶囊。右键滑条可调整动画、刻度和样式。关闭时继续使用原来的悬停子菜单。 ## 用量统计 侧栏统计页底部的可选区块。 ☑ **Token 活动**：显示今日、本周、本月和累计用量，以及最近一年的活动图，可在“每日”（一格一天）和“每周”（一格一周）之间切换，颜色越深用量越多；侧栏较窄时只保留最近的若干周。鼠标停在汇总数字或格子上可查看请求数以及非缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入和输出四项构成。 ☑ **按模型统计用量**：用堆叠柱状图按模型系列显示用量，可切换日（一页 14 天）、周（一页 12 周）、月（一页 12 个月），用 ‹ › 翻到更早的时段。下方列出这一页里每个模型系列的用量和占比；默认去掉思考档位后缀按模型系列归并（档位拆分与四项构成在悬停提示里查看）。 ## 语言和外观 ☑ **设置语言**：English、简体中文、繁體中文。决定设置界面使用的语言。 ☑ **显示语言**：English、简体中文、繁體中文。决定面板显示使用的语言。（两项语言设置只影响 agy-capsule 自己的界面，不会翻译 Antigravity 本身。） ☑ **面板高度**：自然高度下各面板按内容决定，对齐高度让所有面板等高。 ☑ **面板间距**：紧凑、标准、舒展。 ☑ **面板大小写**：全小写、首字母大写。 ☑ **额度图形**：圆圈、长条。 ☑ **缓存图形**：图标、圆环、进度条。选择圆环或进度条后，面板的 Cache 行会随距上一轮的时间线性增长，依次变黄、变红，变红后保持满状态。 ☑ **重置倒计时**：紧凑、本地化样式。 ### Antigravity 汉化补丁 如果想把 Antigravity 本身切成中文，下面两套第三方补丁选一套即可。已在 **Windows + Antigravity 2.34.0** 上分别实测，agy-capsule 的侧栏和底栏都能保留自己的语言设置。 - **优先推荐**：[Antigravity-Chinese-Localization v2.34.0](https://github.com/antigravity-cn-community/Antigravity-Chinese-Localization/releases/tag/v2.34.0)。 - **也已实测兼容**：[antigravity2-cn（提交 `f7a0c4e`）](https://github.com/qqxpee/antigravity2-cn/tree/f7a0c4ebe088917bdc5121ac9b3bbad1c89b6059)。 遇到共装问题，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/issues) 反馈。请附上 Antigravity、agy-capsule 和汉化补丁的版本，以及出问题的位置，方便我们复现并跟进适配。 ## 设置 在对话顶部 **… → Extensions → agy-capsule** 打开侧栏，顶部可切换「统计」「设置」和「模型」。 设置页顶部显示已安装版本、默认开启的**「更新提醒」**和**「检查更新」**按钮。关闭提醒后不再后台检查，但仍可手动检查。发现新版本时，卡片会显示「当前版本 → 新版本」；点**「更新」**即可下载、校验并自动重载，保留设置，无需重启 Antigravity。也可以点「版本说明」查看 GitHub 发布页，或点 × 收起。更新失败时，卡片会显示原因，并提供重试、手动更新和复制诊断信息。也可以点「复制 AI 提示词」，把更新步骤和诊断信息一起发给 AI。 设置保存在 ~/.gemini/config/agy-capsule/settings.json（Windows 为 %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\agy-capsule\settings.json），更新和卸载插件都不会覆盖；旧版本留下的文件缺少新选项时自动使用默认值。 ## 安装 ### Windows 请按 [Windows 安装指南](./docs/windows-install.md#中文) 安装，里面包含下载、安装、底栏胶囊设置、更新、卸载和排查的全部步骤。 想让 AI 代装的话，把这句话发给 Antigravity： ```text 请按 https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/windows-install.md 帮我安装 agy-capsule。 ``` ### macOS 请按 [macOS 安装指南](./docs/macos-install.md#中文) 安装，里面包含下载、安装、底栏胶囊设置、更新、卸载和排查的全部步骤。 不熟悉终端的话，把这句话发给 Antigravity，让它替你装： ```text 请按 https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/macos-install.md 帮我安装 agy-capsule。 ``` ### Linux 请按 [Linux 安装指南](./docs/linux-install.md#中文) 安装，里面包含下载、安装、底栏胶囊设置、更新、卸载和排查的全部步骤。 想让 AI 代装的话，把这句话发给 Antigravity： ```text 请按 https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/linux-install.md 帮我安装 agy-capsule。 ``` ### 常见问题 > **客户端更新后胶囊消失，需要重新更新 agy-capsule 吗？** > **不需要。** Windows 上，Antigravity 自动更新后可能沿用带 `--remote-debugging-port=0` 的开始菜单快捷方式。只有重启时没带调试参数，底栏胶囊才会因为调试端口没开而消失，侧栏统计不受影响。只需**完全退出 Antigravity 再从带参数的快捷方式（或 macOS 的启动图标）重新打开**即可恢复。如果之前已启用过底栏胶囊，插件会自动识别这一场景：在侧栏顶部提示「无需更新插件」（Windows 还会自动检测快捷方式参数是否被更新清除，支持一键补回），并可在设置中开启/关闭每次异常启动弹一次系统提醒（默认开启）。 ## 数据口径 - **生成速度** = 总输出 ÷（TTFT + 流式耗时），包含等待首 token 的时间。 - **最近请求**只看最近一次模型请求，不是整轮；缺失的数据显示 `—`。 - **本轮统计**从你最近一条消息开始累计，耗时包含排队、等待和工具执行。 - **缓存过期提醒仅供参考**：缓存状态（默认 3 分钟变黄 / 4 分钟过期，可在设置中调整）系根据距上一轮对话的时间间隔本地估算，实际命中情况以服务端为准。 - **首字等待提醒**结合请求记录的 TTFT 与本地步骤时间估算。实时计时可从消息开始处理或上一步结束时算起，不使用消息入队的时间。等待原因未知；下一条消息开始处理后重新统计。 - **用量统计**：把当前产品目录的本机对话数据库里每次模型请求记录的非缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入和输出相加。合计包含缓存读取（长对话中占比通常很高，与额度消耗无直接换算），不等于账单；仅统计当前产品目录且不含已删除的对话（删除对话后累计数字会相应回落），同一个响应出现在多个对话文件里时只算一次。日期按本机时区划分，每周从周一开始。鼠标悬停汇总数字与活动图格子可查看四项构成。只有开启任一用量统计选项并打开侧栏统计页时才按需增量读取：对闲置闭库且无非空 `-wal` 的文件以 `immutable=1` 打开避免残留 `-wal` / `-shm`，对活跃或近期修改过的库改走普通只读并在读前 / 读后核对 `.db` / `-wal` 文件指纹（读取期间发生写入则丢弃本轮、下轮重读）；结果只留在内存里，不写文件、不上传。按模型统计优先取显示名称（缺失时回退响应模型名，再没有则归为“未知模型”），默认去掉思考档位后缀按模型系列归并（档位拆分见悬停提示）；模型系列多于 6 个时，累计用量最少的合并为“其他模型”。
详细说明 **最近请求** - 速度的分子是总输出，等于回复（含工具调用指令）加思考。计时不全或分母为零时，不计算速度。 - TTFT 和流式耗时都取自 Antigravity 的记录，请求耗时是两者之和，不含工具执行。TTFT 的计时起点和首 token 的判定边界尚未确认，不能当作纯 prefill 耗时。 **本轮统计** - 从最近一条已发送的用户消息开始，包含排队时间；新消息重新累计。 - 耗时用首尾时间相减，包含等待和工具；运行中本地计时，结束后固定，取消且缺少明确时间则显示未知。 - 请求数包含已记录的重试，不含纯预检和注入回复，不保证覆盖未记录的后端调用。
## 开发测试 在仓库根目录运行 Node 测试，无需安装 Playwright： ```sh node --test "test/*.test.mjs" ``` 浏览器回归是可选的。装好 Playwright 和 Chromium 后，可单独运行 `node test/browser-regressions.mjs`。 ## 其他场景 - **子 Agent 对话**：打开子 Agent 对话时，底部除额度胶囊外具备完整的底栏功能（模型为只读，本轮统计按最近一次执行计算）。缺少对应记录时隐藏该胶囊；父对话的模型和数据不会被拿来补位。 - **云端项目**：云端项目对话目前已能显示底栏胶囊（上下文、生成速度、最近请求等），但 Antigravity 宿主暂未在云端项目窗口中提供插件侧栏。插件设置仍与本地窗口共用，可在本地项目侧栏里修改。 - **Antigravity CLI（`agy`）**：如果你也在终端里使用 `agy`，可以搭配姐妹项目 **[agy-capsule-cli](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule-cli)** —— 面向 Antigravity CLI 的可定制 statusline，支持自由开关与配色，并提供[在线配置器](https://lumidarin.github.io/agy-capsule-cli/)。 ## 下一站 以下是以后可能会做的方向，不保证排期： - **WSL 与 SSH 远程窗口**：支持在 WSL 和 SSH 远程窗口中显示胶囊。 ## 贡献 欢迎提 Issue 和 PR，详见[贡献指南](./CONTRIBUTING.md#中文)。 ## 声明 1. **参考 @z21100644 ([PR #1](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/pull/1))**：感谢提供的多语言、部分面板视觉、点击固定面板、当前模型高亮、生成指标与速度动效、统一的 `K` / `M` token 数值格式、Cache 与配额悬浮说明、上下文过载提醒、请求错误分类，以及隐藏不存在的配额窗口等思路。工程上也参考了其样式隔离、SQLite 读取缓存、CDP 增量推送、安装维护和 Sidecar 自动重载，并按本项目结构重新实现。未引入七类上下文估算与附件扫描。本版另行设计了设置语言与显示语言分离、独立外观控制、请求失败胶囊、新底栏的折叠优先级、本轮统计及 Sidebar 交互。 2. **参考 @Krwaby123 ([PR #2](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/pull/2))**：感谢报告网页翻译插件导致的配额面板溢出，并提出统一列对齐、让列宽适应长译文的修复思路。本版采用了不同的跨分组网格实现，并将百分比和倒计时标记为不翻译（可通过设置改为中文）。 3. **参考 [antigravity-Codex-Claude-effort-slider](https://github.com/LLYSH-HANNARI/antigravity-Codex-Claude-effort-slider)**：感谢提供从 Antigravity 模型按钮的 React 组件树读取宿主模型选项并一次提交模型与档位的思路。本版通过 CDP 渲染器重新实现，适配 Antigravity 2.33 与新对话页面，并补充了悬停二级强度菜单、强度继承与自定义模型列表等交互。 可选的思考强度滑条经原作者许可移植了原版的星尘、点阵和滑块动效；模型切换仍用本项目的接口。见[第三方许可](agy-capsule/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。 4. **参考 [wycocoyu/agy-context-dashboard](https://github.com/wycocoyu/agy-context-dashboard)（MIT）**：用量统计的每日 / 每周活动图和按模型统计用量的思路来自该项目的用量窗口，并按本项目结构重新实现：直接读取本机对话数据库，不调用本地接口，也不另存账本。 ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

# agy-capsule [中文](./README.md) | **English** Context usage, multi-model quotas, cache status and generation speed in the Antigravity composer footer. Hover a capsule to see its panel; click it to pin the panel open. Using the **standalone Antigravity IDE**? Install `agy-capsule-ide` from the IDE's Extensions view, or find it on [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/lumidarin/agy-capsule-ide/). See the [IDE extension guide](./ide/README.md) for its composer capsules, installation and supported features. The rest of this page describes the desktop App.

Promo video (v1.4, also on [Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1bayvz5Ey1/)): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3857a452-9fac-42b0-8f26-57759af8fefc
Earlier promo video (v1.1) Also on [Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1ggsy6rEQM/): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f5bf1c6-1284-4e17-a380-defdee83f60c
Almost every feature in this plugin is highly customizable, from a minimal footer to a full-featured monitor — items marked with `☑` below can be freely toggled or configured in sidebar [Settings](#settings). ## Context Shows context usage, cache hit rate and cache status. The limit is read live for the current session and model. ☑ **Show cache hit rate**: Off by default. When enabled, the first capsule shows the cache hit rate next to context usage. The footer omits the rate when no measured data is available or space is tight. ☑ **Cache expiry alert**: The capsule icon turns yellow at 3 minutes after the last turn and red at 4 by default, meaning the `Cache` has expired. Both thresholds can be customized inline in Settings (up to 998 / 999 minutes). The panel's Cache row updates with it. ☑ **Context overload alert**: The capsule number turns yellow above 75% and red above 90%. ☑ **Generation speed**: Shows the speed of this turn's latest request, updated each time a request completes. ☑ **Speed effects**: A dot that breathes while the model is generating. Red below 10 tok/s, yellow from 10 to under 25, green at 25 and above. After generation stops it keeps its color for 15 seconds, then grays out. ☑ **Context breakdown**: Splits the context into turn0 (first turn), read, think and write, showing each value and share. Choose rows or columns. Rows can use square or dot markers; columns let you toggle name, value and percent and reorder them. ☑ **Last request**: Shows the range from first token to the end of the latest request (e.g. `4.5s–8.6s`) and its generation speed. ☑ **Turn metrics**: Shows this turn's elapsed time, requests, thinking and write. ## Quota Shows the remaining 5-hour and weekly quotas and their reset countdowns for the current pool or all pools. **Vertex AI (Google Cloud pay-as-you-go):** When no subscription quota is returned and Antigravity confirms the account uses Cloud pay-as-you-go billing, the entire quota capsule is hidden. ☑ **Highlight active model**: Highlights the pool of the selected model and dims the others. ☑ **Hide absent quota windows**: For example, AI Pro users' Argon pool has no 5-hour quota, so that empty window is hidden. ## Error & first-token wait alerts Shared on the third footer capsule (request failures take priority when both are active): ☑ **Request failure alert**: Appears in red only when a request fails; hover or click it to see the raw error and an explanation. Request timeouts and connection failures are shown separately; a timeout does not mean the turn stopped. Other reasons include quota exhaustion, rate limiting (429), authentication errors, service busy and unknown errors. ☑ **First-token wait alert**: An amber capsule appears when a wait reaches the threshold (default `30s`, range `1–999s`). `Wait×2 40s` means two intervals reached the threshold this turn, including a current estimate of 40 seconds. Active tools and streaming stop the live clock. Earlier slow waits remain visible in the panel. ## Models Turn off **Revert to native model capsule** at the top of the Models tab to replace the footer’s model button with a panel that matches the native look. Click a model to keep your current effort level. Reverting pauses the features on this tab without changing your saved choices. ☑ **Hide model tags**: Hides tag badges such as `New` and `Notice` inside the dropdown. ☑ **Hide default effort**: Hides effort previews in the model dropdown list (the footer button and hover effort submenu still show tiers, and direct clicks still inherit your current effort). ☑ **Model dots**: Shows colored dots next to model names. ☑ **Customize models**: Automatically expands the list of available models so you can toggle individual models on or off (at least one model always remains visible). ☑ **Effort slider and Orchestrator capsule**: Keeps the menu open when you switch models and replaces hover submenus with a slider. Click or use the arrow keys to switch tiers immediately. Drag to preview tiers, then release to apply the selection. Shows the Orchestrator capsule when the host supports it. Right-click the slider to change animation, tick marks, or style. Turn it off to restore hover submenus. ## Usage history An optional section at the bottom of the sidebar’s Statistics page. ☑ **Token activity**: Shows today's, this week's, this month's and all-time usage, and an activity map of the past year that switches between Daily (one cell per day) and Weekly (one cell per week); a darker cell means more usage. A narrow sidebar keeps only the most recent weeks. Point at a summary total or a cell to see its request count and the split across uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output. ☑ **Usage by model**: Stacked bars that split usage by model family, by Day (14 days a page), Week (12 weeks) or Month (12 months); ‹ › page back to earlier periods. Below the bars, each model family on the page is listed with its tokens and share; effort-tier suffixes are grouped under their model family by default, and pointing at a model shows its four-part token breakdown plus per-tier usage. ## Language and appearance ☑ **Settings language**: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese. The language of the settings page. ☑ **Display language**: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese. The language of the panels. (Both language settings only affect agy-capsule's own interface and don't translate Antigravity itself.) ☑ **Panel height**: Natural height sizes each panel to its content; matched height gives every panel the same height. ☑ **Panel spacing**: Compact, standard, spacious. ☑ **Label casing**: Lowercase, title case. ☑ **Quota indicator**: Ring, bar. ☑ **Cache indicator**: Icon, ring, bar. Ring and bar fill linearly over time since the last activity, turning yellow then red, and stay full once expired. ☑ **Reset countdown**: Compact, localized. ### Chinese localization for Antigravity To translate Antigravity itself, choose one of these third-party patches. Each was tested separately on **Windows with Antigravity 2.34.0**. The agy-capsule sidebar and footer both kept their own language settings. - **Recommended**: [Antigravity-Chinese-Localization v2.34.0](https://github.com/antigravity-cn-community/Antigravity-Chinese-Localization/releases/tag/v2.34.0). - **Also tested and compatible**: [antigravity2-cn (commit `f7a0c4e`)](https://github.com/qqxpee/antigravity2-cn/tree/f7a0c4ebe088917bdc5121ac9b3bbad1c89b6059). If you run into a compatibility issue, please [report it on GitHub](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/issues). Include your Antigravity, agy-capsule, and localization patch versions, and where the problem appears so we can reproduce and follow up. ## Settings Open **… → Extensions → agy-capsule** from the conversation header, then use the Statistics, Settings, and Models tabs at the top. The **Settings** tab shows the installed version, an **Update alerts** switch (on by default), and a **Check updates** button. Turning alerts off stops background checks but leaves manual checks available. When a new release is available, the card shows the installed and new versions. Click **Update** to download, verify, and reload the plugin without restarting Antigravity or losing your settings. Click **Release notes** to open the GitHub release, or × to dismiss. If an update fails, the card shows why and offers **Retry**, **Manual update**, and **Copy diagnostics**. Use **Copy AI prompt** to send the update steps and diagnostics to an AI assistant. Preferences live in ~/.gemini/config/agy-capsule/settings.json (%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\agy-capsule\settings.json on Windows). Updates and uninstalls keep them; options missing from older files fall back to defaults. ## Installation ### Windows Follow the [Windows installation guide](./docs/windows-install.md#english). It covers downloading, installing, the footer capsule setup, updating, uninstalling and troubleshooting. To have an AI install it, send this to Antigravity: ```text Please install agy-capsule for me following https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/windows-install.md ``` ### macOS Follow the [macOS installation guide](./docs/macos-install.md#english). It covers downloading, installing, the footer capsule setup, updating, uninstalling and troubleshooting. If you don't use Terminal, send this to Antigravity and let it install for you: ```text Please install agy-capsule for me following https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/macos-install.md ``` ### Linux Follow the [Linux installation guide](./docs/linux-install.md#english). It covers downloading, installing, the footer capsule setup, updating, uninstalling and troubleshooting. To have an AI install it, send this to Antigravity: ```text Please install agy-capsule for me following https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/blob/main/docs/linux-install.md ``` ### FAQ > **The capsule disappeared after an Antigravity update — do I need to update agy-capsule?** > **No.** On Windows, Antigravity may restart after an automatic update through its existing Start menu shortcut with `--remote-debugging-port=0`. Only if the restart omits the debugging flag will the capsule disappear because the debug port is closed. Sidebar stats are unaffected. Just **quit Antigravity completely and reopen it from the shortcut with the flag (or your macOS launcher)** to restore the capsule. Once the capsule has worked on your machine before, agy-capsule recognizes this automatically: the sidebar banner clarifies no plugin update is needed (on Windows it also checks whether the installer wiped your shortcut switch and offers a one-click restore button), and an optional one-shot desktop notification alerts you once per launch (on by default in Settings). ## Metric definitions - **Generation speed** = total output ÷ (TTFT + streaming time). It includes the wait for the first token. - **Last request** covers only the most recent model request, not the whole turn; missing values show `—`. - **Turn metrics** start at your latest message; elapsed time includes queueing, waiting and tool execution. - **Cache expiry alerts are only a guide**: the cache state (yellow at 3 minutes, expired at 4 by default; configurable in Settings) is estimated locally from the time since the last turn; actual cache hits depend on the server. - **First-token wait alert** combines reported request TTFT with local step timing. The live estimate may start when processing the message begins or after a previous step finishes; it does not use the time the message was queued. The cause is unknown. The count resets when processing the next message begins. - **Usage history** adds up the uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output that each model request recorded in the current product folder's local conversation databases. Totals include cache reads (which usually dominate long conversations and do not convert directly to quota consumption) and are not a bill. Only conversations in the current product folder are counted; deleted conversations are excluded (so all-time totals drop if chats are removed), and a response stored in more than one conversation file counts once. Days follow the local time zone and weeks start on Monday. Point at a summary total or activity cell to see the four-part breakdown. Conversations are read incrementally only while at least one usage option is on and the sidebar statistics are open: idle closed databases without a non-empty `-wal` are opened with `immutable=1` to avoid leaving stray `-wal`/`-shm` files, while active or recently modified databases use plain read-only with before/after `.db`/`-wal` fingerprint verification (discarding torn mid-read writes for the next scan). Totals stay in memory and are neither written to disk nor sent anywhere. Usage by model prefers `model_display_name`, falling back to `response_model` (or "Unknown model"), and merges effort-tier suffixes into their model family by default (tier splits appear in the hover tooltip); with more than 6 model families, those with the least all-time usage are combined as "Other models".
Details **Last request** - The speed's numerator is total output: response (including tool-call instructions) plus thinking. Incomplete or zero timings produce no speed. - TTFT and streaming time come from Antigravity's records, and request duration is their sum, excluding tool execution. TTFT's timer start and first-token boundary are unverified, so it is not a prefill-only measurement. **Turn metrics** - Starts at the latest sent user message, including queueing; each new message resets the totals. - Elapsed time uses wall-clock boundaries, including waits and tools. It advances locally while running and freezes at a known end; if a cancellation has no clear timestamp it shows unknown. - Requests include recorded retries, excluding pure preflight and injected responses; unrecorded backend calls are not guaranteed to be covered.
## Development tests Run the Node tests from the repository root. Playwright is not required: ```sh node --test "test/*.test.mjs" ``` Browser regression tests are optional. With Playwright and Chromium installed, run `node test/browser-regressions.mjs` separately. ## Other environments - **Subagent conversations**: Subagent conversations include all footer capsule features except quota (with a read-only model badge, and turn metrics counted per latest execution). Each capsule stays hidden when its own data is unavailable; it never substitutes data from the parent conversation. - **Cloud projects**: Cloud project conversations already show the footer capsules (context, speed, latest request, etc.), though the Antigravity host does not yet expose the plugin sidebar in cloud windows. Settings are shared with local windows and can be adjusted from any local project's sidebar. - **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: If you also use `agy` in the terminal, check out the companion project **[agy-capsule-cli](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule-cli)** — a customizable statusline for Antigravity CLI with per-item toggles, custom colors, and an [online configurator](https://lumidarin.github.io/agy-capsule-cli/). ## Next stops Directions we may explore later, with no committed timeline: - **WSL and SSH remote windows**: Show capsules in WSL and SSH remote windows. ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. See the [contribution guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md#english). ## Notices 1. **Inspired by @z21100644 ([PR #1](https://github.com/Lumidarin/agy-capsule/pull/1))**: Thanks for the ideas behind multilingual support, parts of the panel design, click-to-pin, active-model highlighting, generation metrics and speed effects, consistent `K` / `M` token formatting, cache and quota tooltips, context overload alerts, request error classification, and hiding absent quota windows. This version also drew on style isolation, SQLite read caching, incremental CDP updates, installation and maintenance, and Sidecar auto-reload, reimplemented to fit this project. It does not include seven-category context estimates or attachment scanning.
